ComposeFile.Name: Pipe Bomb
ComposeFile.Overview: A self-hosted music streaming platform with a plugin system, flexible attribute schema, and an app-quality client.

Variable.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Variable.Label: Public URL
Variable.Description: Only needed if CORS is causing issues. Set to the exact URL you use to access Pipe Bomb (e.g. http://192.168.1.100 or http://pipebomb.local).

Variable.Name: HTTP_PORT
Variable.Label: Port
Variable.Description: Port Pipe Bomb will be accessible on.

Variable.Name: DATA_PATH
Variable.Label: Data Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores its database and core data.

Variable.Name: RESOURCES_PATH
Variable.Label: Resources Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores resources such as album art and thumbnails.

Variable.Name: AUDIO_CACHE_PATH
Variable.Label: Audio Cache Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb caches audio files. Recommended to place on a fast drive (e.g. your cache pool).

Variable.Name: PLUGIN_CACHE_PATH
Variable.Label: Plugin Cache Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores plugin-related cache files.

Variable.Name: PLUGINS_PATH
Variable.Label: Plugins Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb loads plugins from.

Variable.Name: TEMP_PATH
Variable.Label: Temp Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb writes temporary files. Can safely point to fast or ephemeral storage.

Variable.Name: SECRETS_PATH
Variable.Label: Secrets Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores secrets such as the JWT signing key. Keep this on persistent storage.

Variable.Name: MUSIC_PATH
Variable.Label: Music Library Path
Variable.Description: Path to your local music library for the local-library plugin.
